question: How is the knot of karma-named impurity burned up?
premises: The knot is the expansion of karma-named impurity.
It goes to the tip of the spoon.
A full oblation is offered together.
In the radiance of fire-mantra it is burned up.
inference: The knot of karma-named impurity is burned up together with the spoon-tip oblation in the radiance of the fire-mantra through a full oblation.
uncertainties: The exact referent of srugagragam as spoon-tip-going is not fully certain.
plain_english: He would burn up that knot, whose nature is the expansion of karma-named impurity, together with what goes to the spoon's tip, in the radiance of the fire-mantra, by a full oblation.
